poisonPill.why: A doc that silently stops documenting a domain the map still declares. The gate's whole value is catching exactly this — the doc drifted from 12 headings while the map grew to 36, and nobody noticed for months. The tamper removes ONE '### `domain`' heading rather than corrupting the file, because a parser that only checked the '## Domains' section existed, or counted headings without reading their names, would still pass a structural check while missing a real undocumented seam.
